objective: Single-scope CV hotfix: validate summary only against rendered evidence and make fallback rejection observable without widening AI or modifying job rankings.
forbidden_changes: execute migration on production database without separate authorization
acceptance: No AI call when cached analysis is current
No automatic AI calls for nonconfirmed jobs
JD fetch through cache then source API then safe public HTML
Manual pending job evaluation is user-triggered
Terminal UI state for every attempted evaluation
Backend-side spend reservation/limit and request logging
No changed paths beyond allowlist
CV generated only on user action from persisted JD
No unverifiable achievements or credentials
Actual model token billing measured before claiming AI cost
Re-download identical CV without new AI spending
Distinct JD classes produce distinct CV focus
No duplicate factual bullets
No AI requests in CV path
Relevant roles prioritized without changing chronology
Safe filename candidate-role-company
At most one microgeneration call per novel CV key
Persisted cache for identical JD/profile/model
No unsupported achievement claims
Deterministic fallback when AI unavailable or invalid
No changes to global vacancy rating and no new migration
AI may reorder/select verified facts but cannot author new professional bullets
Old cached hybrid resumes invalidated by independent rubric version
deployment: No merge to main or deploy before explicit approval
